summary: Overlay coalescing is complete; the full VM gate passes, all five assigned corpus categories are at zero, and other failures are unchanged.
body:
Changed files:

- [import.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/src/scene/import.rs): prepare overlay coverage before mapping, suppress covered clips, use enclosing intervals, and avoid redundant nested carriers.
- [overlay.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/src/scene/import/overlay.rs): bounded dependency closure and coalescing; shared schema/font indexes.
- [import/tests.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/src/scene/import/tests.rs): successful preservation, interval, clock, uniqueness, and round-trip tests; retained unsupported-dependency refusal coverage.
- [sr_core_corpus.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/tests/sr_core_corpus.rs): previous-round removal of the five assigned ignores and regression entries. The coordinator’s `SAMPLE_REGRESSION` changes are preserved.

The integration defect was that dependency closure retained siblings while the importer still emitted their native or separate overlay clips. Coverage is now resolved first. Later promotions subsume earlier overlays; each retained carrier uses its enclosing container’s interval and visibility. Composition-wide overlays cover the project interval. Original clocks and sequence placement remain inside the overlay document.

Public API unchanged:

```rust
pub fn import(bytes: &[u8], opts: &ImportOptions)
    -> Result<(Imported, Vec<Overlay>, Report)>;
```

New internal API:

```rust
pub(super) fn prepare(
    doc: &SceneDoc<'_>, r: &Resolved,
    roots: &HashSet<usize>, opts: &ImportOptions,
) -> Result<Vec<Plan>>;
```

Design grounding and ambiguities:

- The XSD’s group clock wording leaves the scaling origin implicit. Following [sr-eval/program.rs::Clock::Affine](/home/admin/src/scene-render/crates/sr-eval/src/program.rs:87), child time is `origin + (t − origin − offset) × scale`. Tests verify that origin=2, offset=2, scale=2 maps child [4,8) to global [5,7).
- [sequenceType](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/schema/sr-core/scene-render.xsd:4586) requires preserving auto-placement. Promotion retains the enclosing sequence.
- Generated-ID ownership cannot be determined without executing programs. All build emitters are retained, with references deferred according to [sr-model/program_ids.rs](/home/admin/src/scene-render/crates/sr-model/src/program_ids.rs). Step programs do not satisfy missing references.
- XSD `object3DType/materialOverride` defines name:id pairs; its voxel `palette` defines material IDs except the `file` keyword. Both follow transitive material/texture dependencies.
- XSD `cameraType/geodesics` and [sr-model/rules.rs](/home/admin/src/scene-render/crates/sr-model/src/rules.rs:649) require the black-hole/disk context; the enclosing 3D context is retained.

Closure traversal remains iterative: 100,000 selected nodes, depth 256, and 2,000,000 work units. Existing aggregate generation and 64 MiB output limits remain enforced. **No renderer implementation code was borrowed**; the source files above were consulted for semantics.

TDD red→green, VM only:

| Test | Observed red | Final |
|---|---|---|
| `scene_corpus_external_expression` | Sibling dependency refused | Pass |
| `scene_corpus_generated_id` | Dependency `g1` missing | Pass |
| `scene_corpus_material_override` | MOV2 | Pass |
| `scene_corpus_voxel_palette` | VOX6 | Pass |
| `scene_corpus_geodesic_camera` | BH5 | Pass |
| `scene_import_overlay_external_expression_dependency_preserved_once` | 2 overlays, expected 1 | Pass |
| `scene_import_overlay_promoted_group_interval_and_clocks` | Enclosing overlay carrier missing | Pass |
| `scene_import_overlay_promoted_sequence_keeps_placement` | Covered native sibling count 1, expected 0 | Pass |

The three integration tests also verify export→re-import clip counts. Their fixtures use transparent backgrounds to exclude the exporter’s existing reported synthetic-matte skip. All ten focused closure tests pass, including the node/depth/work budget tests previously observed failing against an unbounded stub. Dynamic-expression refusal remains tested.

Evidence: [original red runs](/tmp/fixoverlay-red-corpus.log), [budget reds](/tmp/fixoverlay-budget-red.log), [integration reds](/tmp/fixoverlay-round1-red.log), [scene green run](/tmp/fixoverlay-round1-green3.log).

The exact required VM gate passed: formatting, Clippy with `-D warnings`, **331 tests passed / 0 failed / 3 existing ignores**, and Wasm for **51 crates**. [Gate log](/tmp/fixoverlay-round1-gate.log).

Pinned corpus comparison, 1,343 cases:

| Failure category | Original baseline | Final |
|---|---:|---:|
| external-expression | 122 | 0 |
| generated-id | 12 | 0 |
| material-override | 6 | 0 |
| voxel-palette | 14 | 0 |
| geodesic-camera | 18 | 0 |
| fractional-depth | 11 | 11 |
| linked-audio | 72 | 72 |

Failure records fell **255→83**, affecting **201→29 cases**. Final totals: 2,020 imports, exports, and schema-oracle checks; 4,040 successful re-imports. The remaining 83 failure records are identical to the previous closure-only run: none added or changed.

The pinned corpus command still exits 101 for those two unrelated categories; its target reports 20 passed, 1 failed, and 3 ignored. The five assigned categories and the no-increase criterion pass. [Corpus log](/tmp/fixoverlay-round1-corpus.log).

No commits, pushes, new dependencies, or attribution updates. Task completed and all coordination locks released.
